d: A tough, conservative security guard suffers a stroke during a bank robbery. His recovery requires voice lessons from his drag queen neighbor. The unlikely pair learn to look beyond their differences and find common ground in friendship.

After middle-aged filmmaker Josh and his wife Cornelia meet a free- spirited twenty-something couple, they adopt a new lifestyle. But with each hilarious attempt to act young, Josh and Cornelia start to appreciate the rewards of growing old together.

Graphically depicting the music and dance heritage of Manchester from the late 70s to the early 90s, the movie documents the vibrancy that made Manchester the place in the world that you would most like to be.

On the eve of her high school reunion, Harley Jane Kozak convinces  best friend Elizabeth McGovern to seduce an old flame, Ken Wahl, so she can get all the juicy details. But when McGovern falls for Wahl, it's like high school all over again!

One week before her sixteenth birthday, a girl realizes that she is the descendant from one of the witches of Salem. She uses her newfound powers to snag herself the football-hero as her boyfriend and to become the most popular girl in school.
Nadine has problems with her mother and brother and considers her father as her only ally. However, things take a turn for worse for her when her best friend, Krista, starts dating her brother.
